# The Deep Roads

*Below the Floodwells, long sally tunnels run out under the hills. Somewhere along them is the tunnel mouth the wanderer came in by. Brindle wants it found: hunt 40 tunnel bats in the Deep Roads and reach the tunnel mouth.*
